provenance.worktree: Migration and unrelated changes present; relevant candidate files individually fingerprinted

scopePolicy: Production = every non-test TypeScript file under minimal-subagents. Local glue/tests retain ALL baseline manifest paths, including inactive leftovers. Shared infrastructure and mentions excluded on both sides; this is source inventory, not disk removal or full dependency closure.

complexity.kind: lexical proxy, NOT cyclomatic or cognitive complexity

protocol.minimal: This is a bounded runtime measurement. Do not use tools, inspect files, delegate, or ask questions. Return exactly PROBE_OK and nothing else.
protocol.inspection: This is a bounded read-only runtime measurement in /Users/fbb/dotfiles. Use the read tool to read only .pi/agent/npm/node_modules/@gotgenes/pi-subagents/package.json. Do not run commands, read other files, modify files, delegate, or ask questions. Return exactly: name=<name>; version=<version>; node=<engines.node>. Replace placeholders with the values read from that file. Return no other text.

runtime.warmupPolicy: One unmeasured fresh-child run per workload; existing warm parent process; no provider-cache flush; serial new children; no concurrent active benchmark worker. Earlier idle sessions may remain retained.
runtime.clock: Date.now milliseconds in parent codemode; wall clock, not monotonic
runtime.verdict: Descriptive historical comparison only; causal improvement inconclusive
limitations: Three measured samples per workload; no statistical significance, p95 or isolated overhead estimate.
Provider/cache state uncontrolled; current child tool/context loading intentionally differs; config fingerprints changed.
Wait returns execution report before storage save. All eight sampled receipts said not-attempted; later native status confirmed saved. Durability latency not measured.
Exact baseline usage unavailable. Candidate usage from native transcripts is supplemental, not token savings evidence.
Old package and inactive integration remain on disk; no installed-disk reduction claim.
No CPU, memory, allocations, cold start, concurrent saturation or real coding workload measured.

collectionNotes: Initial baseline JSON parse hit read output truncation; corrected by paging before any runtime measurements.
Native transcript tool returned tab-delimited TOON, not JSON; parser corrected during warm-up checking, before measured samples.

Initial static collector stopped at page limits and omitted final newlines. Corrected by following nextOffset to EOF, preserving line boundaries and using os.stat bytes. Every final content byte count matched stat allowing only omitted final newline.
GNU stat rejected BSD -f syntax with exit 1; Python os.stat succeeded.
One artifact-writing script had a syntax error before tool calls; corrected without file effects.
No failed runtime samples, retries, discarded outliers, source modifications or dependency changes.
